title: Align legacy Staging recovery support-table cardinality

phases.objective: Keep the legacy local-Staging recovery dry-run guard aligned with the canonical 19-table runtime support contract while preserving fail-closed recovery and mutation safety.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The legacy Clone-StagingDatabases dry-run validates the canonical Staging database role migration manifest before any apply path is allowed.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The legacy dry-run accepts the canonical 19 runtime support tables, rejects the stale 11-table guard, and all related schema-bundle and readiness contracts pass without database or grant mutation.
steps: Read required_runtime_support_tables from the canonical staging-database-role-migration-manifest.json and require exactly 19 entries.
Run the Staging recovery, schema-bundle builder, and database-readiness regression contracts on the exact pull-request head without invoking Recover-StagingDatabases.ps1.
assertions: Clone-StagingDatabases.Legacy.ps1 requires $requiredRuntimeSupportTables.Count -eq 19 and no longer contains the stale Count -eq 11 guard.
The regression contract requires the 19-table legacy guard and explicitly rejects the 11-table guard.
No database recovery, database mutation, grant mutation, Production access, provider mutation, Hostinger mutation, or Cloudflare mutation is performed by this change.
